title: Frequently asked questions
subtitle: In-depth answers about TripleZero iT — from AI and SEO to design, marketing, support and hosting.
ctaText: Can't find your answer? Contact our team and we'll get back to you quickly.

items.question: What does TripleZero iT do?
items.answer: We combine webdesign, WordPress support, digital marketing, search visibility (AEO, GEO/local and SEO), design and hosting — helping brands get found, convert and grow.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Book a call or contact us. We run a short intake, review goals and stack, then propose a clear plan with timeline and KPIs.

items.question: Which types of businesses do you work with?
items.answer: SMBs, scale-ups, ecommerce, agencies and international brands. We work with existing teams and as a full-service partner.

items.question: Do you only work in the Netherlands?
items.answer: No. We serve Benelux and international clients in Dutch and English.

items.question: What does a typical engagement look like?
items.answer: Intake → audit/scan → plan → sprint execution → measurement → optimization, with clear milestones.

items.question: Can I combine multiple services?
items.answer: Yes. Common mixes: webdesign + SEO + ads, or WordPress maintenance + hosting + security.

items.question: How soon can you start?
items.answer: Often within a few business days after approval. Emergency issues (malware, downtime) get priority.

items.question: Do you work remote or on-site?
items.answer: Primarily remote with structured communication. On-site is available on request.

items.question: How do you communicate progress?
items.answer: Regular updates, tickets/dashboard where relevant, plus sprint or monthly reports.

items.question: What do you need from us to start?
items.answer: Access (if needed), goals, brand assets, analytics accounts and existing tool credentials.

items.question: Are you a fit for startups?
items.answer: Yes — from lean landing pages and AI scans to full growth systems as you scale.

items.question: Who owns the work and accounts?
items.answer: You own domains, content, repos and ad accounts. We deliver files and documentation at handover.

items.question: Can you collaborate with our current vendors?
items.answer: Yes. We work alongside your developers/marketers or take over maintenance cleanly.

items.question: What is your AI scan?
items.answer: An AI readiness scan scoring how well your site performs for classic search, AI answers and local/geographic visibility (AEO, GEO, SEO and technical foundations).

items.question: What does the AI scan measure?
items.answer: AEO signals, GEO/local visibility, SEO fundamentals, content structure, performance indicators and AI readiness — with prioritized fixes.

items.question: How often should we run an AI scan?
items.answer: After major site changes or campaigns; for active brands we recommend periodic scans (e.g. quarterly).

items.question: Is AI only about content writing?
items.answer: No. It also covers technical discoverability, structured data, internal linking and how AI systems summarize your brand.

items.question: Can you integrate AI into our workflows?
items.answer: Yes: content assistance, automation, chat/ticket flows and custom AI API integrations.

items.question: Does AI replace your strategy work?
items.answer: No. AI accelerates analysis and production; strategy, brand voice and conversion decisions stay human-led.

items.question: Is AI-generated content safe for SEO?
items.answer: Only with human review, unique insight and E-E-A-T. We avoid thin generic pages that hurt rankings.

items.question: What is AI readiness?
items.answer: How well your site, content and data are structured so AI systems can correctly cite, recommend and explain your brand.

items.question: Do you use AI agents in the dashboard?
items.answer: Yes. Clients can see agents for SEO, content, social and ads with status and tasks.

items.question: Which AI tools do you use?
items.answer: We pick tools per use case, with governance: sources, fact-checking, brand rules and privacy.

items.question: Can AI help support tickets?
items.answer: Yes for triage and faster replies, with human escalation for complex or sensitive cases.

items.question: How is AI work priced?
items.answer: From an entry AI scan to monthly AI + marketing retainers. You’ll get a clear proposal after intake.

items.question: How do we measure AI ROI?
items.answer: KPIs like traffic, leads, time saved, content output, ticket resolution and conversion — defined upfront.

items.question: What’s the difference between AEO, GEO and SEO?
items.answer: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimizes for AI answers. GEO (Geographic Search Engine Optimization) strengthens local and regional visibility in Maps, local packs and location-based search. SEO targets classic search engines.

items.question: Why do AEO/GEO matter now?
items.answer: More users get answers via AI and search locally (“near me”). Without AEO you miss AI citations; without GEO you miss nearby leads — even if classic SEO is solid.

items.question: How do you start an SEO engagement?
items.answer: Technical audit, keyword/intent research, content gap analysis and a prioritized roadmap tied to business KPIs.

items.question: How long until SEO results show?
items.answer: Technical wins can be fast. Organic growth usually compounds over weeks to months depending on competition.

items.question: Do you offer local SEO?
items.answer: Yes: Google Business Profile, local landing pages, NAP consistency, reviews and local content clusters.

items.question: What is technical SEO for you?
items.answer: Crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals, structured data, sitemaps/robots, canonicals, internal linking and error cleanup.

items.question: Do you create SEO content?
items.answer: Yes: briefs, outlines, blogs, landing pages and FAQs matched to intent and structured for AI visibility.

items.question: What is E-E-A-T?
items.answer: Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trust — critical for rankings and credibility in AI summaries.

items.question: Do you do link building?
items.answer: Yes, ethical and relevant: digital PR, partnerships and content assets — never spam schemes.

items.question: Can you recover from SEO damage?
items.answer: Yes: algorithm recovery, toxic links, indexation issues and content cannibalization fixes.

items.question: How do you report SEO progress?
items.answer: Monthly or per sprint: rankings, traffic, conversions, technical issues and next actions.

items.question: Does SEO work for ecommerce?
items.answer: Yes: product/category SEO, faceted navigation, reviews, structured data and buying-intent content hubs.

items.question: Is SEO one-off or ongoing?
items.answer: Best results come from ongoing optimization. One-off audits help, but competitors keep moving.

items.question: Do you support international SEO?
items.answer: Yes: hreflang, market research per locale, localization and multi-locale technical setups.

items.question: Which ad channels do you run?
items.answer: Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, and where relevant YouTube/retargeting — based on funnel and budget.

items.question: How do you set ad budgets?
items.answer: From goals (leads/sales), target CAC, auction prices and a test phase. We start lean and scale winners.

items.question: What’s your Google Ads approach?
items.answer: Account structure, intent mapping, negatives, landing-page fit, conversion tracking and weekly optimization.

items.question: Can you run Meta Ads for ecommerce?
items.answer: Yes: catalogs/retargeting, creatives, audiences and creative testing to improve ROAS.

items.question: How do you measure ad success?
items.answer: Conversions, CPA/CAC, ROAS, lead quality and pipeline — not vanity clicks.

items.question: What if tracking is broken?
items.answer: We fix GTM/GA4/pixels, consent setups where needed and stronger measurement options.

items.question: Do you run B2B LinkedIn Ads?
items.answer: Yes, with sharp targeting, lead forms or landing pages and decision-maker messaging.

items.question: How fast do ads show results?
items.answer: Traffic can be immediate. Stable CPA/ROAS usually needs 2–6 weeks of learning and iteration.

items.question: Do you create ad creatives?
items.answer: Yes: copy, visuals and test variants — design/media creation included when needed.

items.question: Can ads and SEO reinforce each other?
items.answer: Yes. Search insights feed SEO; strong organic pages improve Quality Score and lower CPA.

items.question: Can you take over existing ad accounts?
items.answer: Yes. We audit, restructure and optimize without unnecessary rebuilds.

items.question: How do you prevent wasted spend?
items.answer: Negatives, exclusions, caps, geo controls, frequency limits and fast kill switches.

items.question: Is remarketing still worth it?
items.answer: Yes when privacy-compliant with strong offers — often the most efficient layer.

items.question: What design services do you offer?
items.answer: Logos, brand identity, business cards, letterhead, flyers, posters, stickers, magazines/brochures and digital visuals.

items.question: Which tools do you use?
items.answer: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign for print-ready, professional deliverables.

items.question: Do you deliver print-ready files?
items.answer: Yes: CMYK, bleed, crop marks and proper PDF exports, plus screen variants.

items.question: How does a logo project work?
items.answer: Brief → concepts → feedback rounds → final vectors (SVG/PDF/AI) and basic usage guidelines.

items.question: Can you refresh an existing brand?
items.answer: Yes — update logo, color and type while protecting recognition.

items.question: Do you make social templates?
items.answer: Yes, so your team can publish consistently and quickly.

items.question: Digital vs print design?
items.answer: Print needs color space, resolution and margins; digital needs screen sharpness and speed. We deliver both correctly.

items.question: Can you layout magazines or brochures?
items.answer: Yes, multi-page InDesign work with grids, styles and prepress checks.

items.question: Do you handle printing?
items.answer: Yes. We design and can print in small or large quantities — from business cards and stickers to flyers, posters and brochures — with proofs and production coordination.

items.question: How many feedback rounds are included?
items.answer: Usually 2–3 structured rounds; more available by agreement.

items.question: Do we get source files?
items.answer: Yes, as agreed (AI/PSD/INDD or export packs).

items.question: Can design and webdesign align?
items.answer: Yes. Brand systems and UI stay consistent across print and web.

items.question: Where can I learn more about Digital Design?
items.answer: Visit /digital-design and the Digital Design services in the menu.

items.question: What marketing services do you offer?
items.answer: AEO/GEO/SEO, content, social, ads, ecommerce growth, product listing, community management and data entry.

items.question: How do you build a marketing strategy?
items.answer: Goals, audience, positioning, channel mix, content pipeline and KPIs — practical and executable.

items.question: What is full-funnel marketing for you?
items.answer: Awareness → consideration → conversion → retention, with channel roles clearly defined.

items.question: Do you help with positioning?
items.answer: Yes. Clear positioning prevents scattered campaigns and weak conversion.

items.question: Do you provide content writing?
items.answer: Yes: blogs, website copy, newsletters, landing pages and sales copy.

items.question: Do you do ecommerce marketing?
items.answer: Yes: feeds, listing quality, CRO, ads and category/product SEO.

items.question: What is CRO?
items.answer: Conversion Rate Optimization — improving pages and funnels so more visitors convert.

items.question: How do you report marketing results?
items.answer: Reports/dashboards with traffic, leads, sales, CPA/ROAS and channel learnings.

items.question: Can you work with our in-house team?
items.answer: Yes — execute, advise, or own a specialist lane (SEO-only, ads-only, etc.).

items.question: How fast can campaigns launch?
items.answer: Often within 1–2 weeks after tracking/setup; content runs in parallel.

items.question: Do you support email marketing?
items.answer: Yes: flows, newsletters and copy, including CRM/ecommerce integrations.

items.question: Is marketing always a monthly retainer?
items.answer: Retainers suit ongoing growth; audits, redesigns and launches can be project-based.

items.question: How do you avoid busywork without results?
items.answer: Every activity ties to KPIs. Underperformers get fixed or stopped.

items.question: Which social channels do you manage?
items.answer: Primarily LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and where relevant X/TikTok — based on audience fit.

items.question: What’s included in social media management?
items.answer: Strategy, calendar, creation/scheduling, community replies, reporting and iteration.

items.question: Do you create visuals and video?
items.answer: Yes via media creation: stills, carousels, short-form video and templates.

items.question: How often do you post?
items.answer: Depends on goals — typically 3–5 times/week on core channels, quality over volume.

items.question: Do you offer community management?
items.answer: Yes: moderation, comments, DMs and reputation care with brand voice guidelines.

items.question: Can social and ads work together?
items.answer: Yes. Organic winners become ad creatives; ads amplify what resonates.

items.question: How do you measure social success?
items.answer: Reach, engagement, click-outs, leads and assisted conversions — not just likes.

items.question: Do you work with influencers?
items.answer: On request: selection, briefing and tracking focused on measurable outcomes.

items.question: Can you support crisis communication?
items.answer: Yes, with fast response protocols coordinated with your team.

items.question: Do you help with LinkedIn thought leadership?
items.answer: Yes: personal + company content, carousels, cases and employee advocacy.

items.question: Do you provide a content calendar?
items.answer: Yes — monthly or quarterly themes, formats and deadlines.

items.question: What if we already have a social manager?
items.answer: We can specialize (creatives, ads, strategy) or support peak periods.

items.question: How fast will social grow?
items.answer: Consistency compounds. Meaningful growth usually takes weeks to months; faster with ads support.

items.question: What support do you provide?
items.answer: WordPress support, custom-site support, tickets/live chat, maintenance, security, performance and incident response.

items.question: How do I reach support?
items.answer: Via contact, booking, dashboard tickets or live chat. Urgent issues get priority flags.

items.question: What’s your response time?
items.answer: Fast first response (often within one business day; critical downtime faster). Exact SLAs depend on package.

items.question: Do you offer 24/7 monitoring?
items.answer: Yes in relevant support/hosting packages: monitoring, backups and alerts.

items.question: Can you remove malware?
items.answer: Yes — WordPress and custom stacks — including hardening and aftercare.

items.question: Do you handle WordPress updates?
items.answer: Yes via WordPress maintenance & updates: core/plugins/themes with backups and checks.

items.question: Can you help with hosting issues?
items.answer: Yes — diagnose, migrate or optimize hosting/VPS/domains.

items.question: What if my site is down?
items.answer: Report urgency. We restore via backups, server checks and hotfixes with status updates.

items.question: Is there a client portal?
items.answer: Yes. Logged-in clients see dashboard, tickets, projects and relevant CRM/invoices.

items.question: Can multiple teammates open tickets?
items.answer: Yes, depending on account roles (client/manager/admin).

items.question: What’s in Basic/Standard/Premium support?
items.answer: More sites, faster follow-up and broader coverage (updates, malware, speed, SEO). See support pages for details.

items.question: Do you help with non-technical questions too?
items.answer: Yes — services, billing and account questions, with technical depth based on your package.

items.question: Can I upgrade support later?
items.answer: Yes, as traffic, risk or team needs grow.

items.question: Do you only build WordPress sites?
items.answer: No. Besides WordPress we build custom sites in HTML/CSS/JS, PHP and Next.js — separate from WordPress services.

items.question: What is Website Support?
items.answer: Design, development, maintenance, security, performance, backup/migration and API integrations for custom stacks.

items.question: Can you redesign an existing site?
items.answer: Yes: UX/UI refresh, conversion improvements and technical modernization without a full rewrite if avoidable.

items.question: Do you work with Next.js?
items.answer: Yes — great for fast, SEO-ready marketing sites and dashboards.

items.question: Do you build PHP applications?
items.answer: Yes: portals, APIs, legacy modernization and performance/security hardening.

items.question: How do you handle mobile?
items.answer: Mobile-first design, responsive layouts and testing across common devices/browsers.

items.question: Is accessibility included?
items.answer: We follow solid a11y basics; stricter WCAG programs can be scoped in.

items.question: CMS options without WordPress?
items.answer: Yes: headless CMS, custom admin or static setups depending on your team.

items.question: How long does a web design project take?
items.answer: Landing pages in weeks; larger sites/apps across multiple sprints after intake planning.

items.question: Do you include copy and SEO at launch?
items.answer: Yes when combined with content/SEO so the site launches searchable and conversion-ready.

items.question: What about performance after launch?
items.answer: We optimize Core Web Vitals, caching/CDN and monitoring via maintenance packages.

items.question: Can you integrate APIs (CRM, payments, AI)?
items.answer: Yes, with proper error handling, logging and documentation.

items.question: How is code delivered?
items.answer: Via repo/deploy pipelines where possible, with staging/production and handover.

items.question: Do you help with on-site CRO?
items.answer: Yes: UX improvements, forms, CTAs, experiments and page speed.

items.question: What hosting do you offer?
items.answer: Shared, WordPress and VPS hosting in Basic/Plus/Business tiers, plus domains.

items.question: Shared vs WordPress vs VPS?
items.answer: Shared suits smaller sites. WordPress hosting is WP-optimized. VPS offers more resources/control for heavier loads.

items.question: Do you help with domain registration?
items.answer: Yes — advise, register/transfer and configure DNS correctly.

items.question: Is SSL included?
items.answer: Yes, SSL is included in relevant hosting plans.

items.question: Can you migrate my site to your hosting?
items.answer: Yes: backup, migration, DNS cutover, SSL and smoke tests with minimal downtime.

items.question: How do backups work?
items.answer: Depends on plan: easy or automated backups. Extra off-site retention available.

items.question: What if traffic grows?
items.answer: We scale to Plus/Business or VPS and optimize caching/CDN.

items.question: Is email included with domains?
items.answer: Depends on setup. We advise reliable mail solutions and DNS auth (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).

items.question: How secure is your hosting?
items.answer: SSL/firewall, updates, monitoring and hardening, with optional security services on top.

items.question: Can I move from shared to VPS later?
items.answer: Yes — planned migration with testing and rollback.

items.question: Do you support CDN?
items.answer: Yes where relevant (often included on WP hosting) for faster global delivery.

items.question: What’s your uptime approach?
items.answer: Monitoring, fast incident response and clear communication for maintenance windows.

items.question: Can you fix DNS issues?
items.answer: Yes: records, propagation, mail auth and domain wiring.

items.question: How do I choose the right plan?
items.answer: Based on traffic, stack (WP vs custom), resources and growth. We advise honestly.

items.question: Where can I see hosting prices?
items.answer: On the hosting service pages under Services → Webhosting & Domains.
